status: DRAFT — a separate review authoring part (D-187); not approved, not a production asset
method: deterministic drawing (no image call, no Northstar pixels, no H1): one closed lock shape of two quadratics, filled with one hair grey, an inked outer edge and one inner strand line; drawn in master px and merged UNDER the D-185 hair in the same hair luminance layer at authoring time. No new runtime layer, no z-model change.
coordinates: master canvas 1024x1536, continuous: pixel i covers [i, i+1), x right, y down

registration.earLobeJunctionWhy: the image-right ear's lower junction with the jaw contour: the mirror (x -> 1024 - x) of D-186's ear-front line end (372, 374)
registration.jawContour: the base's own silhouette edge under the ear (x 648 at row 376 to x 625 at row 384)
registration.neckContour: N1's image-right side (x 547 from row 436) — the lock ends above it and never reaches the neck front

side: image-right only, as read visually from Northstar (one short lock below the image-right ear; none on the image-left side)

shape.why: the root lies behind the ear lobe and the jaw (inside the base silhouette, hidden); the lock hangs DOWN from under the ear-jaw junction about 25 px to a free tip at (645, 407), curving slightly outward, as Northstar's lock does; its top is the jaw contour itself, so it reads as hair behind the ear and jaw and never lies on the cheek

behind: lock alpha = coverage x (1 - underlay alpha / 255), and 0 wherever the underlay alpha >= 128: the head, ears, chin and neck always cover it

tones.why: the hair luminance layer's own values: D-185's paint-field grey (70) and ink grey (22); the strand is between them

ink.edges: both drawn edges (outer and inner) are inked; the top edge is the base's own jaw ink
ink.rule: ink only where the lock's own alpha >= 16 (a line never creates hair)
